technique_name: Imagine you are the servant of a noble household in colonial India and describe your typical day
description: As a servant of a noble household in colonial India, my daily routine would typically start with warming up the house by lighting a fire and preparing tea for the household. After that, I would feed the animals and perform household tasks such as washing and cleaning. I was responsible for organizing the kitchen and making sure the food was ready for the noble family's meals.
